top_signals.title: Tennis elite pauses Grand Slam protest after achieving $30m prize money boost
top_signals.summary: Top men’s and women’s tennis players including Jannik Sinner and Aryna Sabalenka have agreed to cease their public campaign for more prize money and power at Grand Slams.
